prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE complete Burning Fuse Joker card for a Balatro mod, Risk class. Regenerate illustration from scratch, preserving concept.
Reference roles: images 1 and 2 are PRIMARY exact finish, paper, frame, typography, shading and pixel-art style references from the SAME SET. Image 3 is ONLY the original concept and dynamic juggling pose; do NOT copy its crude low-detail finish.
Subject: a charismatic red-and-black harlequin/jester with white face, mischievous reckless grin and gold hat bells, juggling THREE easily recognizable red cartoon dynamite sticks with short burning cords, bright small yellow-orange sparks. Dynamic precarious juggling pose, two white-gloved hands open under airborne explosives, slightly bent dancing legs, confident swagger. Explosives follow an unmistakable arc around the head with generous spacing; keep all three separated from costume so readable at tiny size. Strong silhouette, expressive bold face, recognizable red cylindrical sticks with dark bands and cord at one end, no labels required. No real-world construction details. Close full-body composition that fills most of the card, not tiny character in empty space. Two arms/two hands/two legs only.
Style: match first two references VERY closely: polished medium-detail Balatro pixel art, confident black stepped contours, 3-5-tone stepped shading with clear volume, limited red/black/ivory/gold palette. Not overly coarse elementary pixel blocks, not smooth vector, not painterly, not photorealistic, no 3D, no grotesque horror or gore. Small warm highlights on face and gloves from fuses. Modest flat gray ground shadow, mostly clean ivory paper with no yellow staining. Exciting unstable cartoon danger, no big explosion obscuring character.
Frame: EXACT same red Risk ornamental thin frame, small square-loop corner ornaments, cool gray cut-corner outer card edge, proportions and margins as references 1 and 2. Vertical black JOKER with thin red outline upper left and inverted lower right, same placement and scale. No other text. Frame is generated together with illustration.
Output one portrait card aspect 71:95, fills image edge to edge, no exterior white margin or screenshot black bars. Transparent ONLY outside tiny rounded/cut corners; entire ivory paper fully opaque. Must read crisply downsampled to 142x190 and 71x95.
